component.name: Atari File Forge
component.summary: Open and maintain Atari media images

description.p: Atari File Forge browses, edits, validates and converts the floppy, hard-disk and ROM images of the Atari ST, Mega ST, STE, Mega STE, TT030 and Falcon030: ST, MSA, DIM and STX floppies, AHDI-partitioned ACSI, SCSI and IDE drives, and TOS and cartridge ROMs.
The Linux application uses the same filesystem and editor implementation as the web edition, with a GTK file chooser, desktop file associations and private XDG working state.

A bundled architecture-native HxCFloppyEmulator command-line converter opens, creates and verifies supported HFE floppy images and decodes SCP flux captures without requiring a separate host installation.

Open floppy images can be converted between containers. Any of them exports as a plain ST sector image or as MSA, and standard geometries also export as HFE or SCP. Every flux export is decoded again and compared byte for byte with the working sectors before the file is released.

With the official Greaseweazle tools installed, the native edition writes an open floppy image to a connected drive and captures a physical disk back into a new working image, as decoded sectors or as HFE or SCP flux.

Keeps a driver's boot loaders once they have been copied from a drive it prepared, in a boot loaders folder of their own, so every later drive prepared with AHDI or ICD Pro boots on a machine running its original TOS ROM without another drive open. AHDI's loader is refused on a drive partitioned for ICD rather than cut short.

A drive prepared with AHDI or ICD Pro now boots on a machine running its original TOS ROM: both of the driver's loaders are copied from a drive it already prepared, and the prepared partition is flagged as the one to boot. A drive for TOS 1.x gets the DESKTOP.INF that TOS 1.x reads, in its own spelling, rather than a NEWDESK.INF it never opens.

Ships the bundled EmuTOS in the native package, which 0.1.0 left out, so the emulator starts without a TOS ROM of your own. Adds presets for a 1040 STF, 1040 STE, Mega ST, 1040 STFM and 520 STFM with ACSI2STM, a Gotek or a BlueSCSI, and makes TOS 4.00, 4.02 and 4.04 separate choices for the Falcon030.

The first usable release. Opens, edits and saves ST floppy images, MSA, DIM, STX, HFE and SCP containers and partitioned ACSI, SCSI and IDE hard drives with GEMDOS attributes and datestamps preserved; prepares a drive with a hard-disk driver, a desktop and NeoDesk or Geneva set up the way their own installers do; decodes TOS and cartridge ROMs; and boots any machine from the ST to the Falcon030 in Hatari, with EmuTOS bundled so the emulator always works.
Initial import of Atari File Forge.
